text:
maria: Quick sync — I'm pulling together the long-term platform roadmap sketch for routing, multi-region, and multi-tenant isolation. Before I lock scope, want to capture customer-driven asks and sensible launch criteria. High-level tradeoffs: strict isolation (higher cost) vs soft isolation (lower cost, easier scaling). Thoughts?

alex: Agree we need SLO guardrails up front. We can't promise region-level latency SLAs without affinity and pre-warming. Also need clear metrics for cross-region spillover.

jin: +1. Proposal: phase features. Phase 1 (Q3): regional affinity routing + soft-eviction lanes + telemetry (per-tenant p99 latency, error rate, cross-region traffic). Phase 2: enforced tenancy lanes, reserved capacity, and on-prem install path.

tara: From sales: a couple of pilot customers want EU residency + private control plane by Q4. They'll accept soft isolation for now if we provide audit logs and encryption-at-rest. On-prem asks will likely be legal-driven.

maria: For launch criteria we should be concrete. My draft: must-have (for initial public beta) = 1) regional affinity and explicit fallback policy, 2) tenant-level cost/latency telemetry surfaced in Console, 3) simple routing DSL for customers to set affinity and fallback, 4) documented canary/rollback playbook. Anything missing?

alex: Add automatic KV/prefix caching metrics (hit rate) to must-have. If caching behavior is opaque, customers will hit cost surprises.

jin: Agree. Also need a small policy example to show customers. Draft snippet:
```
routing_policy {
  affinity: "region:eu-west-1"
  fallback: ["region:us-west-2", "model:quantized-small"]
  isolation: "soft"  # soft | strict
}
```
This stays intentionally small so we can iterate.

tara: ETA constraints: customers expect an initial beta in ~10 weeks. If we push on strict isolation, that'll slip to next quarter. Recommend we position Q3 beta as "Affinity + Observability + Fallbacks" and Q4 for strict isolation + private deploy.

maria: Sounds reasonable. We should capture gating metrics for the beta: 1) <=5% cross-region spill during normal traffic, 2) Console shows per-tenant token cost within 48h of deploy, 3) End-to-end canary rollback <5m. If these fail, we hold release.

alex: Ops checklist for gating: chaos tests for region outage, load test with tenant-mix (p95/p99 tails), SLO dashboard with burn rates. I'll own that.

jin: I'll own routing DSL + policy enforcement proto and a doc with migration patterns (how to move tenants from soft->strict). Will put a PR with examples and the above snippet.

maria: Action items: @alex create gating dashboard + test matrix (due 2w), @jin PR for DSL + migration doc (due 2w), @tara gather pilot customer list and their non-negotiables (due 1w). Ops-bot: link canonical roadmap doc.

ops-bot: Document link: https://redwood.internal/roadmaps/terrain-mapping (internal) — updated outline posted.

maria: Great — I'll integrate these into the roadmap draft and share next Tue for review. If anyone has objections to the phased approach, flag now. Otherwise I'll mark scope as "Affinity+Observability+Fallbacks" for beta. :thumbsup:

alex: :thumbsup:

tara: :thumbsup: we'll prep customers.

jin: No objections. Will start the PR.
